cases.narrative: He allegedly decapitated her and tossed her head out into the hallway while she came to visit him at his apartment. He reportedly called 911 and told the dispatcher he had bipolar disorder and that he had just killed his mother. When police arrived at the apartment building where Jeffrey lived on 6th Street, they discovered Surgent nude, lying on top of his mother's decapitated body.
